app.iriai.proto.event.title: Event sidecar
app.iriai.proto.event.ingestion: Ingested from Jetstream and paired with its community event in the same repository.
app.iriai.proto.event.compatibility: Sits beside a community.lexicon.calendar.event record, so calendar apps that read the community event keep working; its locations array carries a copy of the sidecar location.

app.iriai.proto.defs.title: Event view and version
app.iriai.proto.defs.ingestion: Not a record. eventView is what the query API returns for each event; eventVersion carries both record CIDs for editing.
app.iriai.proto.defs.compatibility: The method lexicons that reference these views ship in a compatible v0.2.0; the service already answers the documented shapes.
